artifact.title: Billing summary lifecycle
artifact.trigger: Billing staff compiles accumulated job costs into a new client-facing billing summary.

story.goal: Compile accumulated job costs into a clear client-facing billing summary so the client understands what they are being charged for.
steps: Billing staff reviews labor, material, and approved change order costs for the project.
Billing staff assembles a client-facing billing summary that breaks down labor, materials, and change orders.
Billing staff shares the billing summary with the client for review before an invoice is generated.
story.outcome: A clear billing summary with labor, material, and change order breakdowns is prepared and shared with the client.
